I originally used my sink tap in the kitchen, but it was hard to know how close to get to it or where it should be in the frame to make the picture match (especially when half asleep).  Using a large painting and just making it fill the whole frame has worked well.  Such a simple yet brilliant idea! HOWEVER - one annoying issue.  The app saves the photo I take EVERY morning to my gallery. I have a gallery FULL of pictures of this painting. If I don't remember to delete them right away they get synced to G+ and it's just a real pain to constantly delete them.  It's a nice painting but I don't need five pictures a week of it.  Surely there's some way to make them temporary? I'd give five stars if this issue was fixed. text: This alarm is brutally effective. The lack of a snooze function really forces you out of bed, since that's the only way to shut the thing up. But if the alarm is linked to a picture of something in your house, and it goes off while you're away from the house (e.g. while traveling), the only way to turn it off is to wait for it to time out, or pull the battery on your phone.     Recently, I forgot to turn off one of my weekend alarms, and it went off while I was in a crowded bus on the way to work. I got a bunch of annoyed looks while the alarm blasted at full volume. Needless to say, it was pretty embarrasing. I finally just pulled the battery from my phone to turn it off. Be sure to check the app before you leave the house!

Bleek hij gewoon naast mijn bed te liggen! Nou, na deze lichamelijke oefening èn drie sommen was ik wel wakker! Meer soorten puzzeltjes als unlocker, of een samenwerking met youtube waarbij je één filmpje van een bepaald abonnement te zien kunt krijgen, een geïntegreerde verjaardagskalender zouden de verlijding op sociale media te gaan doen afnemen en dus de efficiëntie van de ochtendroutine nog verhogen :) Maar sowieso super app, kunt veel aan de manier van wakker (gemaakt) worden aanpassen en het nieuwsoverzicht met weerbericht geven op een korte overichtelijke manier de stand van zaken in de wereld die je net weer bent binnengekomen weer!  Een maand later - superapp! Je leert er sneller van hoofdrekenen, iets waar het bij de meeste mensen van onze (20j) generatie nogal aan schort, dus dat vind ik een grote plus. Je moet wel echt zorgen dat hij niet op een ongepast moment gaat; je hebt hem natuurlijk niet zo maar uit (tip: in noodgevallen gewoon je mobiel uitzetten)  In het kort: - Bereikt zijn doel - Plus: rekenvaardigheid trainen - Pas op wanneer je hem zet/aan hebt staan

text: I enjoy Alarmy, but I found two loopholes that weaken its anti-snooze features. First, "Disable Alarm Editing Before Ringing" can be bypassed by simply turning the feature off in settings, allowing alarms to be edited or deleted. Second, "Wake-Up Check" can be canceled by typing a confirmation message, making it easy to go back to sleep. Locking these options would make the app more effective for users who tend to bypass alarms and increase the value of Premium.

text: Ótimo aplicativo de alarme, bastante confiável. Eu o baixei para parar de perder a hora porque eventualmente o alarme nativo do Android não dispara e dá aquela mensagem "Alarme perdido", problema irritante e extremamente básico que ocorre desde sempre no Android, e com o Alarmy nunca tive esse problema! O mais legal é a opção de complicar para desligar o alarme ou resolvendo equações matemáticas, ou escaneando algum código de barra específico, ou tirando uma foto, ou se quiser o modo insano, pode precisar de vários em sequência, aí é impossível voltar a dormir. Minha única crítica é que a soneca é sempre um botão, mesmo no modo problema matemático, que é o que eu uso. Então é necessário resolver a equação para desligar o alarme, mas não para colocar em soneca. Deveria ser o mesmo mecanismo no modo soneca também, senão é possível perder hora da mesma forma...

text: Diferencia-se dos demais apps que já utilizei por permitir tirar uma foto como método de descarte do alarme. Esse é um baita recurso para aqueles que sempre estão perdendo a hora, pois vai obrigar a pessoa a levantar da cama e ir fotografar o mesmo local ou objeto registro. Enfim, nos restante se assemelha aos demais apps. Acho que algumas configurações poderia ficar vinculadas a cada alarma e não universalizadas para todos os alarmes, o que de certa forma torna o app menos personalizável. Fora isso, como já disse, merece 5 estrelas.
